eligibility.scope: the complete original v2 set; Texas is outside this inherited 11-dataset scope
eligibility.on_inapplicable_dataset: stop with incomplete scope; no deletion, substitution, or alternate condition

transform.implementation: scripts.input_robustness_data.fit_transform_features_bounded; same historical formula and float64 training statistics, one training block at a time and chunked float32 output, with exact parity tests against scripts.run_mlp_optimization_diagnostic.fit_transform_features
transform.normalization: unchanged PyG NormalizeFeatures on the complete transductive feature matrix
transform.scale: one scalar: sqrt(mean((raw_train - mean(raw_train, axis=0))**2)) / sqrt(mean((normalized_train - mean(normalized_train, axis=0))**2))
transform.centering: subtract normalized train column means from every node
transform.on_nonfinite_or_near_zero_rms: fail; no clamp, per-column scaling, or condition substitution

data_binding.cache_policy: read only; preserve original node ordering, labels, features, and graph version
data_binding.on_missing_or_mismatch: stop; no silent download, reprocessing, cleaned-graph replacement, or relaxed match

execution.device_policy: fixed before preflight: H2GCN uses CPU for every dataset and condition; its CUDA sparse.mm path lacks a strict deterministic-dispatch guarantee; no runtime fallback
execution.on_unsupported_deterministic_operation: fail; no warn-only mode, implementation substitution, or device fallback

preflight.timing_projection: 2 * [sum(max_repeat_mean_epoch_seconds across all model/trial/dataset/condition cells) * 500 * 10 + sum(max transform/setup seconds + max worker nontraining overhead seconds per dataset/condition) * 70 + sum(max H2 preparation seconds per dataset/condition) * 10]; bounded probe estimate, not a guaranteed upper bound
preflight.limitations: seed 0 and three steps are a bounded deterministic/resource probe, not a proof for all ten seeds or 500 epochs

resource_budget.on_cap_or_estimate_exceeded: stop before formal launch or stop active execution; preserve incomplete artifacts and require a documented outcome-blind resource amendment

evaluator.inference_status: post hoc; dataset-level descriptive uncertainty, no independent confirmatory claim

calibration.tie_rule: smallest threshold within 1e-12 of minimum equal-weight training-dataset mean raw regret
calibration.fit_scope: other ten datasets within the same condition and fixed portfolio; selected-model test outcomes are explicit meta-training targets
calibration.heldout_scope: held-out dataset outcomes never select its threshold
calibration.non_nested_limit: condition and portfolio are fixed analysis strata, not nested-selected candidates; their prior post-hoc choice and overlapping dataset folds preclude independent confirmation

failure_and_resume.write_policy: atomic exclusive append-only output in a new run directory
failure_and_resume.resume_unit: whole completed model unit; interrupted units remain incomplete
failure_and_resume.failure_artifacts: retain every failed attempt; a validated external-interruption resume requires an explicit attempt record, never deletion of failures
failure_and_resume.outcome_adaptation: forbidden: no changed seeds, datasets, grid, conditions, architecture implementations, or selected favorable subset based on validation/test outcomes

pairing: both conditions retrain all seven original architectures with identical data, split, initialization seed, grid, runtime and device; never mix new MLP and historical graph records
inference: post-hoc robustness of this candidate input treatment under the fixed 11-dataset training recipe; no universally optimal preprocessing or new independent confirmatory-validation claim
